title: Fixed Flared Ribbed Shell and Curved Stage
description: One newly authored complete fixed outdoor performance-shell appearance. A broad continuous D-shaped raised stage supports one thin but finite flared arch shell: its narrow high rear grows continuously into a much wider and taller open forward mouth. The whole curved roof and side fields have a genuinely empty interior, a separate entire shaped rear closure and seven full longitudinal radial ribs rooted over the shell exterior. Two rear leaning supports and their complete foot blocks connect the back shell to the same stage. This is neither a low rectangular stage with an imported roof nor a four-pier spherical sail vault: the directional expanding mouth, deep closed narrow back, full fanlike exterior ribs and curved stage edge form one newly authored venue module. No old meshes or geometry imported. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, full horizontal-bounds-centred ground datum. One complete architecture prop zero scenes, no performer or furnishings. Fixed illustrative appearance only: no acoustic amplification, sound distribution, weatherproofing, performance operations, audience access, fall protection, structural thrust, load, construction, installation or safety capability. No rigging animation interaction made.
